achievements.name: Calçotada Popular
achievements.description: Hold a non-referendum, non-binding, consultative participative process on independence.

achievements.name: Junts pel Sí
achievements.description: Form the Junts pel Sí electoral coalition.

achievements.name: Pandemic Year
achievements.description: End the game by reaching the year 2020.

achievements.name: Más sabe por Perro que por Sanxe
achievements.description: After being ousted from the PSOE and winning back its leadership, have Pedro Sánchez become Presidente.

achievements.name: Je me Souviens
achievements.description: Have an independence consultation with an almost incomprehensible question.

achievements.name: You've been PSOE'd
achievements.description: Negotiate and make possible a PSOE-led Gobierno, only for the agreements to go unfulfilled.

achievements.name: Mas o Març
achievements.description: Playing as a party part of the JxSí coalition, refuse to give up Artur Mas' leadership, resulting in new elections.

achievements.name: La Paperera de la Història
achievements.description: Playing as the CUP and while not being part of the JxSí coalition, force Artur Mas to step aside.

achievements.name: Asalto a los Cielos
achievements.description: Have Podemos or Unidas Podemos surpass the PSOE in seats at the Congreso and reach the presidency.

achievements.name: Barones del PSOE
achievements.description: Have the Barons of the PSOE successfully oust Pedro Sánchez and keep him away from the leadership for the rest of the game.

achievements.name: Junts (de debò) pel Sí
achievements.description: Include the CUP into the JxSí electoral coalition or, as the CUP, join into the JxSí coaltion.

achievements.name: Majoria No Silenciosa
achievements.description: Somehow, manage to lose a non-agreement referndum or non-binding consultation to the "No" option.
